acceptanceMatrix.criterion: DoD 1: Concurrent posts/edits/reactions/replies/replay retain exact IDs; tombstones preserve replies.

acceptanceMatrix.requiredChange: Compile commands first. message.create returns one canonical ref per successful commandId; store parentRef/rootRef and validate that replies belong to the same canonical parent. CAS update/delete against expectedRevision; return a conflict with current revision rather than overwrite. Persist body revisions and tombstone state without cascading replies. reaction.toggle must dedup the operation before toggling so retries do not invert state twice. Mutation, receipt and outbox share one SQL transaction; projections apply at-least-once events without duplicate rows/IDs.
acceptanceMatrix.verification: Later run messaging-domain tests with concurrent posts, two edits at the same revision, repeated reaction toggle command, reply plus root deletion, process reload and duplicate/reordered replay. Assert exact refs/revisions, one winning edit and a conflict, exact reaction actors/count, one message per command and preserved reply root/tombstone. Repeat against the committed live service with recorded receipt/ref/hash; fixture UI is separate.

acceptanceMatrix.verification: Submit device A cursor 12, B cursor 8, concurrently with replay, then reload both and assert persisted cursor 12 and exact unread projection. Hover/focus list rows and render hidden/denied transcript; assert no markRead command or SQL state change. Then expose a permitted message and assert a monotonic advance. acceptanceMatrix.criterion: DoD 5: Revoke open websocket/API/tool blocks writes and cached body/search/push leakage.
acceptanceMatrix.currentEvidence: authorizeRox2Action (601-609) is actor/permission grant matching only; it does not accept parent/membership/revision. acceptanceMatrix.requiredChange: Check current membership/author/moderator/revision under every command/query/tool and websocket replay delivery, not only at initial connection. On revoke, deny pending/new writes, stop unauthorized subscription delivery, clear connected cached body/snippet/attachment preview and search/attention/push projections according to policy. Mentions/follows are not grants. Never silently convert a failed human send into an agent operation.
acceptanceMatrix.verification: Live authenticated A/B websocket and API/tool clients: grant then load a private body, revoke while open, race a queued write/replay/search/push, and assert denied receipts, no mutation/outbox disclosure, absent cached text/snippet/facet/push content and denied direct reads. Reconnect/reload remains denied. Document that a disconnected device cannot be guaranteed physically erased. A generic global permission result alone cannot pass this gate.
acceptanceMatrix.missingPrerequisite: Resource-scoped ACL authority plus live websocket/tool/search/push invalidation contracts.
